outcome_summary: The project successfully migrated the repo-parallelizer credential system from a single-token-per-host model (Record<string,string>) to a named multi-credential array model (GitCredentialEntry[]) across the full vertical stack — core types, config parsing with backward-compatible auto-migration, REST API, orchestrators, and the GUI. All 10 work packages were delivered with 896/896 server tests and 199/199 GUI tests passing at zero TypeScript compile errors, and 5 security audits found no Critical or High severity issues. The primary open items for the next cycle are: removing the now-dead legacy injectCredentials() function, persisting credential-error badge state across page reloads in the workspace detail view, and addressing the four documented Medium security observations in a dedicated hardening work package.
